summary: Two nearly identical bottles come across the counter and only one earns a refund.
realLife: Oregon residents questioned the different treatment of soft drinks and newer drinks sold in much the same packaging.
inGame: The bill catalog supplies the bottle-deposit question. needs: beverage category and active coverage list.

turns.what: A clerk checks the beverage inside each bottle against the new coverage list.
turns.pulledBy: The purchase falls under the new coverage list.
turns.writesBack: The refund entry identifies the eligible beverage.

turns.what: After coverage is withdrawn, a shopper takes the excluded bottle home for curbside recycling if that service exists.
turns.pulledBy: The excluded category has no outstanding refund right and the household has service.
turns.writesBack: The empty goes into an accepted curbside stream.
